headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty fell sharply, marking the longest weekly losing run in 25 years

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: NSE trading holiday in observance of Gandhi Jayanti
Massive sell-off by foreign investors during the previous trading session
Benchmark indices recorded their eighth consecutive week of losses
Global market volatility and bond-driven selloffs pressured domestic sentiment
whatHappening: Sensex closed 570.59 points lower at the end of the last session
Nifty50 ended Thursday's trading at 22,421.95 points
Indian markets experienced their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years
Inox Air Products filed draft papers for its initial public offering
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Gandhi Jayanti after the Sensex and Nifty fell sharply in the previous session. Thursday's decline marked the eighth consecutive week of losses, the longest such streak for Indian benchmarks in 25 years. Heavy foreign institutional selling and weak global cues continue to impact the market landscape.
